articles.title: Roman telescope passes steady-pointing tests and sees its first stars
articles.summary: NASA’s Roman telescope passed tests of its steady pointing, and its Coronagraph Instrument received cosmic light for the first time. Early star images will help engineers prepare for more demanding observations.

articles.title: Australian stick insects turn out to be five species, not two
articles.summary: Researchers found that Australian stick insects classified as two species actually belong to five. Their detective work identified two new species, including one whose eggs have an unusual lid structure.

articles.title: Tiny ancient fossils may reveal an early magnetic navigation system
articles.summary: Researchers examined magnetic fossils dating back 97 million years. Their internal structures suggest that an unknown ancient creature may have used Earth’s magnetic field to navigate.
